# 2Hands - AI Agent Management Platform

> 2Hands is an AI-powered agent management platform that enables users to delegate complex computer tasks to autonomous AI agents running on virtual machines.

## Overview

2Hands provides a conversational AI Manager interface powered by Claude that orchestrates specialized AI agents. These agents can perform web research, email management, data entry, form filling, and other computer-based workflows autonomously.

## Key Features

- **AI Manager Chat**: Conversational interface for task delegation
- **Autonomous Agents**: Self-running AI workers on virtual machines
- **Web Research**: Automated data collection and analysis
- **Email Automation**: Read, compose, and send emails
- **Form Filling**: Complete forms and data entry tasks
- **Screenshot & Reports**: Visual documentation of agent actions
- **Secure Credentials**: Encrypted vault for service authentication
- **Scheduling**: One-time, recurring, or continuous agent execution

## Use Cases

- Lead generation and prospecting
- Competitor monitoring and market research
- Email management and responses
- Data entry and form processing
- Content gathering and summarization
- Social media monitoring
- Document processing workflows

## Security

- AES-256-GCM encrypted credential storage
- Human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive actions
- Isolated virtual machine environments per agent
- Enterprise-grade data protection
- No persistent credential storage on VMs

## Pricing

- Free tier available
- Starter, Pro, and Business plans
- Credit-based execution model
- No credit card required to start

## Technical Details

- Web-based platform (SaaS)
- Mobile apps for iOS and Android
- API access for developers
- Integration with Slack, Gmail, and other services
- Real-time streaming updates
